subject: Espaços, Tempos, Quantidades, Relações e Transformações
description_pt: Manipular materiais diversos e variados para comparar as diferenças e semelhanças entre eles.

components.description_pt: Manipular variedade de materiais usando mãos e sentidos durante brincadeira
components.description_en: Manipulate a variety of materials using hands and senses during play

components.description_pt: Comparar similaridades entre diferentes materiais através do manuseio direto
components.description_en: Compare similarities between different materials through direct handling
components.cc_component_description: Analyze and compare two- and three-dimensional shapes, in different sizes and orientations, using informal language to describe their similarities, differences, parts (e.g., number of sides and vertices/"corners") and other attributes (e.g., having sides of equal length).

components.description_pt: Identificar diferenças entre materiais baseado em propriedades físicas observáveis
components.description_en: Identify differences between materials based on observable physical properties

components.description_pt: Classificar materiais por características compartilhadas ou contrastantes descobertas na exploração
components.description_en: Classify materials by shared or contrasting characteristics discovered through exploration
components.cc_component_description: Classify objects into given categories, with up to 10 objects in each category

cc_matches.description: Classify objects into given categories; count the numbers of objects in each category and sort the categories by count.

Analyze and compare two- and three-dimensional shapes, in different sizes and orientations, using informal language to describe their similarities, differences, parts (e.g., number of sides and vertices/"corners") and other attributes (e.g., having sides of equal length).
